# @sharadox/metadata-web-library

> SEO/share/install metadata for Next.js App Router sites, built on @sharadox/internationalization-web-library locales.

- `/page-metadata` pageMetadata({ name, url, locales, locale, title, description, path?, titleTemplate? = "%s · name" (shared SEPARATOR), keywords?, indexable? = true, image? { path, alt } (share card for sub-pages, which otherwise lose it) }) → Metadata (metadataBase, title template, canonical, hreflang alternates incl. x-default, openGraph with locale/alternateLocale, twitter summary_large_image, robots, formatDetection, publisher, appleWebApp title)
- `/sitemap` localizedSitemap({ url, locales, paths? = [""], priority?, otherPriority?, changeFrequency? = "monthly", lastModified? })
- `/robots` robots({ url, indexable })
- `/manifest` webManifest({ name, shortName?, description?, id? = "/", startUrl? = "/", backgroundColor, themeColor, icons? = DEFAULT_ICONS }) → standalone, online-only
- `/structured-data` <StructuredData data /> ; `/structured-data-graph` structuredDataGraph(...nodes)
- `/share-image` shareImage(jsx, { width?, height?, fonts? }) → ImageResponse; SHARE_IMAGE_SIZE 1200x630
- `/application-icons` applicationIconFiles(svg, render, { tolerance? = 0.02 }) → files from one master (src/app/icon.svg: square, full-bleed background, mark centered at MARK_SHARE = 50% of the side): src/app/favicon.ico (16/32/48), src/app/apple-icon.png (180), public/icon-192.png, icon-512.png, icon-maskable-512.png (same picture: the mark is in the safe zone), profile-picture.png (1080); throws ApplicationIconError when not square or the mark isn't 50%. A textured background (photo, texture) goes in an element with id="background" (BACKGROUND_ID), left out while measuring (withoutBackground). Command: `application-icons [master]` (`app-icons` still works until the next minor version) (needs @resvg/resvg-js)
- `/social-image` SOCIAL_IMAGES { "landscape.png" 1920×1080, "portrait.png" 1080×1920, "landscape-headline.png", "portrait-headline.png" (with the site's headline), "background-landscape.png" 1920×1080, "background-portrait.png" 1080×1920, "background-square.png" 1080×1080 (nothing on them), "email-card.png (768×432, shown at display 256×144)" 256×144 with 12 px corners; each { width, height, mark, headline, radius } }, socialImageScale(image) (shorter side / 1080), socialMarkSize({ width, height }) (half the shorter side, SOCIAL_MARK_SHARE), isSocialImageName(name). Sites draw them with shareImage and serve them at /<locale>/social/<name>
- `/render-svg` renderSvg(svg, size) → { size, png, pixels } ; `/ico` icoFile([{ size, png }]) → .ico bytes
- Peer deps: next, react, optional @resvg/resvg-js (app icons). License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- `/llms-text` llmsText({ title, summary, details?, sections: [{ title, lines, style?: "list" | "numbered" | "plain" }] }) → Markdown llms.txt
- `/security-text` securityText({ contact (string or list), canonical, expires? = build + 1 year, preferredLanguages?, policy? }) → RFC 9116 text for /.well-known/security.txt
- Changes by version: CHANGELOG.md (in the package)
- `/route` route handlers for a site's files (segment settings like `dynamic` stay literal in the route file): textRoute(text, contentType?) → { GET } (llms.txt); fileRoute(path, contentType? = markdown) → { GET } (LICENSE.md from the application's folder); securityTextRoute({ url, contact, preferredLanguages?, … }) → { GET }; socialImageRoute({ locales, render }) → { GET, generateStaticParams } (every SOCIAL_IMAGES name in every language; 404 for others); localizedShareImage({ locales, alt, render }) → { size, contentType, alt, generateStaticParams, image } for [locale]/opengraph-image and twitter-image
